title: UK Legal Aid Agency: Hackers stole records dating back to 1978

title: Cisco Warns of Active Attacks Exploiting New Critical Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
summary: Attackers are exploiting a critical flaw in Cisco Secure Email Gateway that lets a sender with no login write files to the appliance's operating system, Cisco said in an advisory on Wednesday.
